description: The Floor: cheap, deterministic checks that run before any scoring judgment is needed. Demo rule set — generic, not tied to any real product or company.

rules.description: Rejects generic high-pressure spam phrasing outright.
A message should make one ask, not stack several questions on the reader.
Flags a message that references a date too old to still read as timely.
A message with no addressed recipient or subject is not ready to be scored as real outreach.
